purpose: source-backed mechanical/adapter diagnosis, not policy acceptance or hardware identification

variant_semantics.vendor: immutable vendor mechanics, explicit wheel PD, original integrator
variant_semantics.damping_only: zero passive viscous damping; retain actuator damping
variant_semantics.inertials_only: copy compiled Isaac body-frame mass, COM and full inertia
variant_semantics.effort_only: copy source contract calf actuator effort bound 320 Nm
variant_semantics.mechanics: combine damping/armature/inertials/effort; explicit wheel PD unchanged
variant_semantics.mechanics_implicit: mechanics plus force-limited wheel velocity servos and implicitfast

reference: current nominal Isaac training asset; not measured real B2W
contact_probe: same initial state and full recorded targets from Isaac upstream10000, no actor feedback in MuJoCo replay
contact_interpretation: finite-horizon descriptive divergence; no long-trajectory equivalence/pass claim

micro_screen.criteria: unchanged locomotion57_v1, diagnostic subset only; 120 episodes

budget: local only, short probes and 120 diagnostic policy episodes; no PPO or server jobs
